description: Source code implementing ASN.1 structures and methods for F1AP private information elements in a 3GPP-related project.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Represents a choice type for private IE ID with options for local or global.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for ASN.1 sequence representing a private IE field with id, criticality, and value.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for container items holding private IE data with pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specific option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c type to local and returns the local ID.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c type to global.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit_ref or cbit_ref.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit_ref or cbit_ref.
